in_sanskrit.name: अकश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The primordial sky or aether, a deity or personification of space, infinite and boundless, in Hinduism and Jainism.

in_hindi.name: अकाश
in_hindi.meaning: आकार द्वारा अक्सर उत्पन्न हुए स्थान सामग्री का नाम, या स्वतंत्र कृपालु देव का नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: The collection of matter that is formless and infinite, or the name of a benevolent deity in Hinduism.

in_tamil.name: அகாச
in_tamil.long_meaning: The unmanifest, the infinite, or the space that surrounds everything in Tamil tradition.

in_telugu.name: అకేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The formless and infinite, or the deity of the sky and space in Telugu tradition.

in_marathi.name: Akashy
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sky, space, infinite
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akashy हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘akasha’, meaning ‘space’ or ‘sky’. In Hindu mythology, Akash represents the sky and the ether, which holds all creation. This name signifies the vastness and infinite nature of the universe.
